content.title: 情态动词综合复习·义务/推测/modal + have done 速查
content.intro: 情态动词后接动词原形,表达说话人的态度:必要、建议、许可、能力,以及对现在或过去的推测。判断口诀:看语境给的『证据强弱』和『时间(现在 / 过去)』——现在推测用『情态 + do/be』,过去推测用『情态 + have done』。

rows: must / have to：Astronauts must wear a spacesuit outside.
should / ought to：You should rest before the launch.
may / can：Visitors may take photos here.
can / could / be able to：She could stay calm in danger.
must be/do：The lights are on, so someone must be inside.
can't be/do：It moves too fast; it can't be a star.
may / might / could be：There might be life out there.
must / can't / should / needn't / could + have done

specialRules.rule: must have done = 对过去有把握的肯定推断
specialRules.mark: The ground is wet; it must have rained.

specialRules.rule: can't have done = 对过去绝无可能的否定推断
specialRules.mark: He can't have seen it; it was too cloudy.

specialRules.rule: should have done = 本该做却没做(批评/后悔)
specialRules.mark: You should have checked the tank.

specialRules.rule: needn't have done = 做了却没必要
specialRules.mark: You needn't have worried; all went well.

specialRules.rule: could / might have done = 过去本可能(往往未实现)
specialRules.mark: She might have inspired a whole generation.

why: 现在推测看『现在的证据』→ 情态 + 动词原形;过去推测看『过去发生的事』→ 情态 + have done。把握程度从强到弱:must(几乎肯定)> may/might/could(也许)> can't(几乎不可能)。
gaokaoPoints: must / have to 在肯定句都表必要,但否定:mustn't = 禁止,don't have to / needn't = 不必。
情态 + have done 是语法填空与单选高频:must have done(肯定) / can't have done(否定) / should have done(本该)/ needn't have done(白做了)的语义辨析。
情态动词后一律接动词原形,must to / can to 都是错的。

examVsReal.exam: You must finish it today.（考试:强制）
examVsReal.real: You've got to finish it today.
examVsReal.note: 口语里常用 have got to / gotta 表必要,书面用 must / have to。

examVsReal.exam: It must have rained last night.（考试:对过去肯定推测）
examVsReal.note: 口语 must have 常缩成 must've,听力里要听出 /əv/ 这个弱读。
